The Evaluating Worker's Own Pool Handle

Source: R/pool.R
mizu_current_pool.Rd

Inside a pool task, mizu_current_pool() returns the pool handle of the worker evaluating the task — the handle to pass to mizu_submit() for nested submission (subtasks push onto the worker's own work-stealing deque, and a worker blocked collecting them helps instead of sleeping). Outside a task, it returns NULL.

Usage

mizu_current_pool()

Value

A pool handle (class "mizu_pool") inside a pool task; otherwise NULL.

Details

The handle is runtime-owned: the pool sets it around each task evaluation, so unlike a variable binding it cannot be shadowed by a task argument or a local assignment.

Examples

p <- mizu_pool()
t <- mizu_submit(p, {
  s <- mizu_submit(mizu_current_pool(), x * 2L, x = x)
  mizu_collect(s, timeout = 30)
}, x = 21L)
mizu_collect(t, timeout = 30)
#> [1] 42
mizu_pool_stop(p)
